days.mission_in: Look for a shadow that makes a pattern on the ground as you walk.
days.entry: Mom and Dad went for a walk. The shadow of the jamun tree was making a very beautiful pattern on the road because of the street light. A milkman was going on his cycle. It was nice.

days.entry: Mom and Dad walked today. They noticed that the jamun tree had some fruit on the ground, and they stepped around it. The milkman's cycle bell rang twice as they walked to the end of the lane.
